newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia April crude palm oil output up 7.24 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia April crude palm oil output up 7.24 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's crude palm oil output rose 7.24 percent to 733,245 tonnes in April from 683,719 in March and against 615,676 in April 1996, the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) said on Thursday.
April palm oil exports were 570,067 tonnes against 579,642 in March and 533,653 in April 1996, it said.
PORLA said Peninsular Malaysia's crude palm oil output rose 5.15 percent to 538,322 tonnes in April from 511,944 in March and 461,974 in April 1996.
Output from east Malaysian states of Sabah and Sarawak rose 13.48 percent to 194,923 tonnes in April from 171,775 in March and against 153,702 in April last year.
Malaysia's palm kernel oil production fell 0.36 percent to 91,114 tonnes in April from 91,446 in March and against 83,680 in April 1996.
